comments.body: Review, 23 Sep: all 53 rows and 9 questions checked against the filing and against Alex's hand-collected rows and August voice notes. Changes: CSC/Pamplona bids #31, #38, #43 now Light (exclusivity recorded, not treated as a downgrade); Party B's 09/18 bid #40 Heavy for uncommitted financing; Initiation now mixed; #21 keeps 16 as a stated assumption (Q3, to confirm with Alex); #8 moved to round 0 so Round opened leads round 1. Q1, Q2, Q4, Q5, Q7, Q8 and Q9: agree, and all match Alex's hand data. Still open: R01's same-price Bid rows (09/21-23 final package, 10/05 and 10/08 sponsor-liability proposals) are not yet added.
